label: AP analyst, every country says urgent

taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How much support did you get from your manager this week?
How connected are you with your team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: Every country team emails saying their invoices are urgent, but there's no set priority order so I waste time asking around and keep missing my daily quota. Last Tuesday Vietnam and Thailand both asked for same-day payment, and my lead was unhappy with which one I processed first.
What would help you know which country's invoice to process first?
A simple priority order from my lead, or having just one designated person who decides, would really help.

Here is what I will tell HR: The employee reports missing daily quotas because multiple teams request urgent invoice processing without a set priority order. [ROLE_CLARITY] "there's no set priority order so I waste time asking around and keep missing my daily quota"
